examples.en: If Erik Spoelstra is not the coach of the Heat, who will be?
examples.zh: 如果埃里克·斯波尔·斯特拉不再是热火主教练，谁可能是呢？

examples.en: "We have the ultimate respect of them as champions," Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said.
examples.zh: “他们是冠军，我们对他们无比尊重，”热火队主教练斯波尔·斯特拉说。

examples.en: Spoelstra said there is no sense from the coaching staff about having to protect the knee.
examples.zh: 斯特拉说，教练组应该没有任何理由的来保护他的膝盖。
